changelog: 🔐 Stay signed in for real. Ticking "Stay signed in" now keeps the admin page and the user panel signed in for 30 days instead of 12 hours, and a server restart or redeploy no longer signs anyone out: sign-ins are saved in the database, by hash only. Signing out, changing the admin password or turning on two-factor sign-in still ends them, and a restart cannot bring them back.
